result.description:
A growing commercial cleaning and facilities services business is seeking an experienced Corporate Services Manager to oversee business operations, service delivery, client relationships and portfolio performance across South Australia, Victoria and Western Australia.

This is a senior management position suited to someone with strong experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations, client relationship management, workforce leadership and operational performance.

The successful candidate will work closely with the executive leadership team to ensure operational standards, labour performance, compliance, client satisfaction and business growth objectives are achieved.

About the Role

The Corporate Services Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and improving the administrative, operational and commercial functions of an allocated portfolio.

The role will involve oversight of service delivery, client relationships, staffing, performance management, compliance systems, reporting, audits, business improvement and portfolio development opportunities.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can manage competing priorities, support Area Managers and site teams, maintain strong client relationships and contribute to the continued growth and professionalism of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Oversee the administration and operational performance of cleaning and facilities services across the allocated portfolio.
Work with the executive leadership team to support business planning, portfolio performance and strategic objectives.
Monitor labour-to-sales performance, roster structures, site profitability and operational results.
Manage client relationships and act as a senior escalation point for service delivery matters.
Identify opportunities for account growth, additional works, recharges, tender opportunities and new business leads.
Support tendering, quoting and commercial submissions where required.
Lead, support and performance manage Area Managers, Supervisors and cleaning teams.
Ensure appropriate staffing, training, succession planning and workforce coverage across the portfolio.
Monitor compliance with company systems, operational procedures, WHS requirements, audits, toolbox talks and site documentation.
Ensure cleaning standards, site presentation and service quality meet company and client expectations.
Support injury management and return-to-work processes in line with company HR and WHS protocols.
Review site performance data, audit outcomes, customer feedback and operational risks.
Implement process improvements to strengthen consistency, productivity and service delivery.
Represent the business professionally in client meetings, operational reviews and portfolio development activities.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate will ideally have:

Previous experience in a senior operations, corporate services, facilities management or commercial cleaning management role.
Strong experience managing multi-site service delivery teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.
Experience with labour management, rostering, cost control and performance reporting.
Understanding of WHS, compliance, audits and quality standards in a service-based environment.
Ability to lead managers, supervisors and frontline employees across multiple locations.
Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Commercial awareness, including the ability to identify growth, quoting and additional service opportunities.
Strong computer literacy and ability to use business systems, reporting tools and operational platforms.
Current driver licence and willingness to travel as required across the allocated portfolio.
Qualifications

Relevant qualifications in business, management, operations, facilities management or a related field will be highly regarded.

Equivalent industry experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations or service-based management will also be considered.

What We Offer
Senior full-time management role with a growing service-based business.
Salary range of $115,000 - $135,000 per annum plus superannuation.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Opportunity to work closely with the executive leadership team.
Broad portfolio responsibility across SA, VIC and WA.
Long-term opportunity to contribute to business growth, service improvement and operational excellence.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience in corporate services, facilities services, commercial cleaning operations, client management and team leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates with the right skills, experience and work rights for the role.
result.title: Corporate Services Managers

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a results-driven and commercially minded ICT Business Development Manager to join our team and play a pivotal role in expanding our market presence across Australia. This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within the ICT sector, while nurturing existing client relationships to drive sustained revenue growth. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of ICT products and services, a consultative sales approach, and a proven track record of exceeding targets. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, aligning our solutions with their evolving technology needs.
## Key Responsibilities
- Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities within the ICT sector, building a robust pipeline of prospective clients across target industries.
- Visit and engage with both existing and prospective client organisations to understand their ICT environments, uncover challenges, and present tailored solutions that address their specific needs.
- Develop and execute strategic business development plans in alignment with organisational goals, market trends, and revenue targets.
- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and senior leaders across client accounts.
- Promote and articulate the value of the organisation's ICT goods and services to clients through presentations, proposals, demonstrations, and consultative discussions.
- Assess and analyse customer requirements to recommend appropriate products, services, and technology solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

1. Position and Business Details

Position Title:

Store Manager

Employing Entity:

Craigieburn Express Pty Ltd (ACN 691 003 960 / ABN 20 691 003 960)

Trading Name:

I Love Dumplings Express

Business Address:

14/330 Brookfield Boulevard, Craigieburn VIC 3064

Nature of Business:

Take-away and quick-service restaurant specialising in dumplings, wok dishes, fried rice, fried noodles and related Asian cuisine

Employment Basis:

Full-time

2. Position Summary

The Retail Manager (General) is responsible for the day-to-day management and commercial performance of I Love Dumplings Express, a take-away restaurant trading from Craigieburn Village Shopping Centre, Craigieburn VIC. The role holds full operational and financial accountability for the store, including product and menu range, stock and supplier management, pricing and promotion, customer service standards, staff supervision, financial record-keeping, budgeting, and compliance with food safety and occupational health and safety obligations. The position requires sound commercial judgement, strong people management skills, and a working knowledge of the quick-service food retail environment.

3. Key Duties and Responsibilities

The Retail Manager (General) is responsible for, but not limited to, the following duties:

Determine the stock levels and service standards for I Love Dumplings Express to ensure the range of dumplings, wok dishes, fried rice, noodles, snacks and beverages offered meets customer demand and maintains consistent food quality and availability across the trading day.
Formulate and implement purchasing and marketing policies, and set prices for menu items, taking into account ingredient costs, supplier terms, competitor pricing and seasonal demand, to protect the profitability of the business.
Promote and advertise the goods and services of the establishment, including planning in-store promotions, social media and local marketing activity, and liaising with delivery platform partners to build the store's customer base and repeat trade.
Sell goods and services to customers and advise them on menu items, ingredients, spice levels and dietary considerations (including vegetarian options), ensuring a high standard of customer service at the counter and for takeaway and delivery orders.
Maintain accurate records of stock levels and financial transactions, including daily sales reconciliation, cash handling, EFTPOS and point-of-sale reporting, and stocktakes of food and packaging inventory.
Undertake budgeting for the establishment, including forecasting sales and controlling food, labour and overhead costs against budget, and reporting on trading performance to the director.
Control the selection, training and supervision of kitchen and front-of-house staff, including rostering, on-the-job training in food preparation, hygiene and customer service standards, and performance management.
Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and food safety requirements, including those under the Food Act 1984 (Vic) and Council registration conditions, and oversee safe work practices in food handling, storage and service.

4. Skills, Knowledge and Experience Required

Relevant qualification in business, retail management, hospitality management or a related field, and/or at least three years of relevant full-time experience in retail or food service management.
Demonstrated experience in managing product/menu mix, stock control and supplier relationships within a retail or food service environment.
Sound understanding of pricing, budgeting and financial record-keeping for a small to medium retail business.
Proven ability to recruit, train, roster and supervise staff in a fast-paced customer service environment.
Working knowledge of food safety standards and occupational health and safety obligations applicable to food premises in Victoria.
Strong customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.
5. Working Conditions

The position is based at I Love Dumplings Express, 14/330 Brookfield Boulevard, Craigieburn VIC 3064. The role is full-time and may require work across a rotating roster including evenings, weekends and public holidays in line with the trading hours of the business, consistent with standard practice in the retail and food service industry.

6. Remuneration

Remuneration will be paid in accordance with the applicable modern award and/or relevant employment contract, and will meet or exceed any minimum salary threshold applicable under the relevant skilled migration program.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Support Technician to join our team and provide reliable support across our computer infrastructure, software systems, and web technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, maintaining hardware and software environments, and ensuring end users receive timely and effective assistance. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills and a genuine passion for technology. This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering high-quality technical support.
## Key Responsibilities
- Assess software and hardware requirements to identify appropriate technical solutions and resolve user-reported problems effectively.
- Respond promptly to enquiries from staff regarding software and hardware issues, providing clear guidance and practical resolutions in a professional manner.
- Install, configure, and maintain approved software applications, ensuring systems remain up to date, secure, and aligned with organisational standards.
- Adapt and modify existing programs and system configurations to better meet the evolving needs of end users and business operations.
- Implement, configure, and monitor computer networks, supporting both wired and wireless infrastructure to maintain consistent connectivity across the organisation.
- Design, update, and maintain organisational websites, ensuring content accuracy, functionality, and a positive user experience.
- Repair and replace peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, monitors, and modems, maintaining accurate records of assets and service activity.
- Provide first- and second-level technical support to end users, either in person, remotely, or via a helpdesk or call centre environment, logging all incidents and resolutions through the appropriate ticketing system.
- Promote the efficient and effective use of applications and equipment across teams, offering training and guidance where required.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to escalate and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct routine system checks, preventative maintenance, and performance monitoring to minimise downtime and ensure infrastructure reliability.
- Maintain thorough technical documentation, including user guides, network diagrams, and records of system configurations and changes.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate III or IV in Information Technology, or a relevant tertiary qualification in ICT, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a technical support, helpdesk, or IT operations role.
- Solid understanding of computer hardware components, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and common business software applications.
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral devices.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
- Familiarity with web technologies and basic website maintenance, including content management systems.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues efficiently and accurately.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and maintain composure under pressure.
- A customer-focused approach with a professional and courteous manner in all interactions.
## Preferred Qualifications
- CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent industry certification.
- ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL service management principles.
- Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) or enterprise IT environment.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365, Azure, or Google Workspace.
- Experience with remote desktop tools and helpdesk ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Freshdesk, or Jira Service Management.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint protection solutions.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the ICT field.
- Enjoy a stable, full-time permanent role with a competitive salary and superannuation package.
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance in a forward-thinking organisation.
- Work with modern technology and contribute to meaningful projects that directly support business operations and user experience.

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
